points: Mozilla blocked the intermediates via OneCRL on 17 October, one evening after the report
Firefox ESR 115.43.1 ships the block list for clients without Remote Settings
German reporting says eight intermediates used private key values between 0 and 255
take: Trivially guessable CA keys let anyone mint trusted TLS certificates. Patch browsers and trust stores, and check whether any of your certificates chain to eMudhra.
title: Mozilla: blocks compromised eMudhra intermediate CA certificates
